# 4BLANC

> > Professional nail care equipment featuring advanced HEPA filtration, UV-C sanitization, and dust collection systems for salon environments.

4BLANC specializes in high-performance nail station and dust collector equipment designed for professional salons. Their flagship products—Maestro Ultimate Protection Nail Station and Alizé Nail Dust Collector—combine advanced air filtration technology with professional-grade accessories and comprehensive support resources.

## Key Topics

- Maestro™ Ultimate Protection Nail Station
- Alizé™ Nail Dust Collector
- HEPA-12 Filtration
- HEPA-11 Filtration
- UV-C Sanitization
- Cyclone Technology
- Air Filtration
- Nail Salon Equipment
- Professional Nail Care
- Shadowless LED Lamp
- Rolling Stand Accessories
- Dust Collection Systems
- Salon Accessories
- Professional Tools

## Flagship Products

- [Maestro™ Ultimate Protection Nail Station](https://4blanc.com/products/maestro-nail-station): Maestro nail station with HEPA-12 filtration and UV-C sanitization
- [Alizé™ Nail Dust Collector](https://4blanc.com/products/alize-nail-dust-collector): Alizé pedicure dust collector with HEPA-11 filtration and LED lighting
- [Maestro™ Collection](https://4blanc.com/collections/maestro): Maestro Ultimate Protection Nail Station product collection
- [Alizé™ Collection](https://4blanc.com/collections/alize): Alizé Nail Dust Collector product collection and accessories
